identity.normalization: Packet list already ID-2 normalized (Water/Aqua/Eau one entry); normalized one-based positions; 22 entries.

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2 (amphoteric), followed by Coco-Glucoside @3 (nonionic), Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @4 and Disodium 2-Sulfolaurate @5 (mild anionics; C3b: sulfolaurate is mild anionic). The C3b sulfolaurate confidence limit does not apply because the sulfolaurate is not the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant. Counter-signal recorded: two mild anionics.

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful conditioning system, cationic polymer Polyquaternium-47 @11 (prominent), plus light routes (weak refatter PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @10, humectants Panthenol @13, Glycerin @15). C2 not met: no silicone or payload lipid and no pearlizing/fatty route. Counter-signal: the polymer sits after Piroctone Olamine @9 (capped active), so it is likely low-level; low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: low: only a single light cationic polymer (Polyquaternium-47 @11) and a weak refatter (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @10) deposit; no silicone, no payload lipid, no protein or film former. W2: both families sit after Piroctone Olamine @9 (a capped active usually dosed well below 1 %), so their combined residue is plausibly below noticeable; moderate confidence because the reset is weak (C6 low chassis), neighbor moderate.

excluded: PEG-200 Hydrogenated Glyceryl Palmate @6 (PEG ester thickener, 6.4)

weightPotential.depositionLoadRationale: One cationic polymer and one weak refatter, both after a capped active.
weightPotential.persistenceRationale: No silicone or lipid; a single polymer plus refatter is weakly retained.
weightPotential.resetCapacityRationale: C6 low chassis (betaine/glucoside-led with mild anionics).
weightPotential.counterevidence: Weak reset means the polymer is not actively offset; Polyquaternium-47 is a substantive polymer.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and low-persistence; no converging persistent systems.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: the two families are a single light cationic polymer and a weak refatter, both listed after Piroctone Olamine @9, so noticeable residue is unlikely even with a mild chassis; moderate stays the realistic neighbor because reset is weak.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Polymer level unknown under INCI-only evidence; weak reset.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional, claim-dependent: claims hidden. The formula carries a recognized anti-dandruff active (Piroctone Olamine @9) and a mild chassis, so scalp_active is the likely claim candidate if dandruff or scalp positioning appears; lengths-care routes are nonspecific.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: No claims visible in the blind pass.

focusSecondary.rationale: Provisional empty default; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional default regular; dandruffSupport is supported, so a qualifying dandruff claim would fire treatment (U3); frequency wording could fire frequent (cleansing not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional: positioning hidden. CSA met: prominent comfort route Panthenol @13; prominent humectant/refatting routes Glycerin @15 and PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @10; mild C6 chassis is supportive. dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine @9 (Section 11). Formula fact only; the dandruff path needs a dandruff claim (R17.3).
